proposed_concepts.name: Intermittent Relational Reinforcement
proposed_concepts.definition: The manipulative relational pattern wherein a toxic or narcissistic individual alternates unpredictably between hostility/cruelty and sudden affection/repentance (hoovering), specifically deployed when the victim attempts to detach, generating powerful psychological entrapment.

proposed_concepts.name: Relational Baseline Deprivation
proposed_concepts.definition: The psychological erosion caused by persistent emotional neglect or cruelty, wherein an individual's expectations of basic decency and emotional safety are degraded to the extent that minimal, common-courtesy gestures are celebrated as profound proof of love.

proposed_concepts.name: Trauma Bond Conditioning
proposed_concepts.definition: A maladaptive, addictive attachment bond formed between an abuser and a victim as a consequence of cyclical intermittent reinforcement, severe emotional threat, and sporadic relief, resulting in intense perceived loyalty that mimics love but is biochemically conditioned entrapment.
